description: This file declares the NetworkChangeNotifier class and related enums and observer interfaces for monitoring system network changes, including connection type, DNS, bandwidth, and network interfaces. It provides static methods for managing observers, querying network state, and platform-specific support.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier
classes.description: Main class for monitoring system network changes, managing observers, and providing network state queries. It supports platform-specific implementations and various observer interfaces for network events.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::IPAddressObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for IP address changes, deprecated in favor of NetworkChangeObserver.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::ConnectionTypeObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for connection type changes, deprecated in favor of NetworkChangeObserver.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::DNSObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for DNS configuration changes.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::NetworkChangeObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for general network changes, such as network availability, IP address changes, and routing table updates.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::MaxBandwidthObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for changes in maximum network bandwidth.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::ConnectionCostObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for changes in network connection cost.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::NetworkObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for network connection events on Android.

classes.name: net::NetworkChangeNotifier::DefaultNetworkActiveObserver
classes.description: Observer interface for default network high power state notifications on Android.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Returns the factory object for creating platform-specific NetworkChangeNotifier instances.

methods.name: SetFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom factory for creating NetworkChangeNotifier instances.

methods.name: CreateIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates the singleton platform-specific NetworkChangeNotifier if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: GetConnectionCost
methods.description: Returns the estimated cost attribute of the current network connection.

methods.name: GetConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current connection type (e.g., WiFi, 4G).

methods.name: GetConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns the subtype of the current connection (e.g., LTE, GPRS).

methods.name: GetMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Provides maximum bandwidth estimate and connection type.

methods.name: AreNetworkHandlesSupported
methods.description: Checks if platform supports network handles API.

methods.name: GetConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Retrieves list of currently connected networks (Android).

methods.name: GetNetworkConnectionType
methods.description: Returns connection type for a specific network handle (Android).

methods.name: GetSystemDnsConfigNotifier
methods.description: Returns the system DNS configuration change notifier.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Indicates if the default network is in high power state (Android).

methods.name: IsOffline
methods.description: Checks if the device is offline.

methods.name: IsConnectionCellular
methods.description: Checks if the connection type is cellular.

methods.name: ConnectionTypeFromInterfaceList
methods.description: Infers connection type from a list of network interfaces.

methods.name: AddNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for network change events.

methods.name: RemoveNetworkChangeObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer for network change events.
